unlisted_practices: Monitor regulatory interoperability challenges between the EU AI Act and sector-specific medical device regulation and address them in a timely manner before they chill innovation.
Conduct continuous monitoring and further research on the EU AI Act's impact on innovation and SMEs and on the effectiveness of its innovation-support measures such as AI regulatory sandboxes.
Incorporate evidence-based scholarship and feedback into continuous improvement of the EU AI Act so it is fit for purpose.
Empirically evaluate European medical AI innovation activity before and after the EU AI Act becomes operational.
Expand the availability, capacity, and capability of notified bodies to carry out conformity assessments of AI/ML-enabled medical devices.

screen.reason: This is an article/commentary addressing the regulatory implications and governance of the EU AI Act for digital medical products.
